gen-gf-alatsi-fs-literata: Literata is a sophisticated serif with a mellow, bookish swing and sturdy thin lines. And Alatsi, plain and low in contrast, gives that warmth a clean surface to stand against.
gen-gf-albert-sans-fs-literata: Neutral and smooth, Albert Sans runs like drawn wire, its curves lifting off before the loop closes. Literata, a serif of gentle modulation, deserves a generous size so its paragraphs stay comfortable.
gen-gf-alef-fs-literata: Pincers for c's, crisp and contemporary: that's Alef up top. Literata then settles into paragraphs with a sturdy, stone-carved heft that feels sophisticated and bookish, page after page.
gen-gf-alegreya-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified, editorial presence: Alegreya swings mellowly from heavy to light without turning fragile. And Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined, adds low-contrast clarity with generous space where curves meet the stem.
gen-gf-alegreya-sans-fs-literata: Alegreya Sans is approachable and contemporary, with tightly kerned pairs and wide apertures. But Literata, the text serif, swells only slightly in its bowls, so paragraphs read smooth and bookish.
gen-gf-alegreya-sans-sc-fs-literata: Alegreya Sans SC flares its terminals outward like tongs, approachable and contemporary. Literata follows with gentle modulation, a sophisticated, bookish partner whose sturdy lines keep the page firmly grounded.
gen-gf-alegreya-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Curves that refuse to close, yet keep real weight at their thinnest, give Alegreya SC its classic, authoritative bearing. Bespoke Sans then reads sharp and refined, with low contrast and generous space.
gen-gf-alice-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined with generous room at its curves, while Alice cuts stencil-like letters with a worn-charcoal shadow. Alice earns its keep in big, short lines.
gen-gf-alike-fs-bespoke-sans: Alike excels at editorial display, with weight changes present but never dramatic. Bespoke Sans does its best work in text, sharp and low in contrast with generous space around curves.
gen-gf-alike-angular-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with generous space around curves. Alike Angular handles authority, with understated stroke variation and a clearly visible c, while the body quietly carries low-contrast text.
